LALITHAA.d: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited retails gold, diamond, silver, and platinum jewellery through physical showrooms. It serves retail consumers primarily in southern India.

LALPATHLAB.d: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd. provides diagnostic and healthcare testing services through a wide network of laboratories and collection centers. It serves individual patients, hospitals, and healthcare providers across India.

LANDMARK.d: Landmark Cars operates a dealership network for major passenger vehicle brands in India, providing sales, service, and spare parts. It is a prominent retail partner for luxury and mass-market original equipment manufacturers.

LAOPALA.d: La Opala RG manufactures and markets opal glass tableware and crystal glassware. Its products are sold to households and the hospitality industry through a wide distribution network.

LASERPOWER.d: Laser Power & Infra manufactures various types of electrical cables, conductors, and galvanized steel wires. Its main customers include power distribution utilities and infrastructure companies.

LATENTVIEW.d: Latent View Analytics Limited provides data analytics, consulting, and digital solution services. It serves clients across technology, consumer goods, and financial services industries.

LAURUSLABS.d: Laurus Labs Limited manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates, and finished dosage forms for global pharmaceutical companies. It also operates a contract development and manufacturing organization business.

LEAPIND.d: LEAP India Limited provides supply chain and asset pooling services, focusing on wooden pallets and containers. It serves various industries including FMCG, consumer durables, and e-commerce.

LEMONTREE.d: Lemon Tree Hotels owns and operates a chain of midscale and upscale hotels across India, catering to business and leisure travelers. It is one of the largest hotel chains in the midpriced hotel sector in the country.

LGBBROSLTD.d: LG Balakrishnan & Bros manufactures roller chains, sprockets, and automotive components primarily for two-wheeler and industrial applications. It is a major supplier to Indian vehicle manufacturers.

LICHSGFIN.d: LIC Housing Finance Limited provides long-term housing loans to individuals and developers. It is a subsidiary of Life Insurance Corporation of India and serves retail home buyers across the country.

LICI.d: Life Insurance Corporation of India offers individual and group life insurance policies, pension products, and unit-linked plans. It is India's state-owned and largest life insurance provider.

LINCOLN.d: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals manufactures a wide range of pharmaceutical formulations in various dosage forms. It exports generic medicines and healthcare products to numerous countries globally.

LINDEINDIA.d: Linde India produces and distributes industrial and medical gases, and designs cryogenic engineering plants. It is a subsidiary of the global gases company Linde plc.

LLOYDSENGG.d: Lloyds Engineering Works Limited designs and manufactures heavy engineering equipment for sectors like hydrocarbons, steel plants, power, and marine. The company provides customized machinery and turnkey engineering solutions.

LLOYDSME.d: Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited operates iron ore mining and generates thermal power. Its products serve domestic steel and energy markets, and it operates captive mines in Maharashtra.

LMW.d: LMW Limited manufactures textile machinery, machine tools, and precision castings for the textile and engineering industries. It is one of the largest textile machinery manufacturers globally.

LODHA.d: Lodha Developers Limited develops residential and commercial real estate projects primarily in the Mumbai metropolitan area, Pune, and London. It constructs housing and office spaces for retail buyers and corporate clients.

LT.d: Larsen & Toubro engages in engineering, procurement, construction, manufacturing, and heavy engineering projects. It is India's largest engineering and construction conglomerate.

LTF.d: L&T Finance Limited provides rural business finance, urban finance, and farmer finance services. It caters to retail customers and small businesses across India.

LTFOODS.d: LT Foods processes and markets specialty rice and food products, notably under the Daawat brand, serving retail and foodservice customers worldwide. It is a major global player in the Basmati rice market.

LTTS.d: L&T Technology Services provides engineering, research, development, and digital solutions for various industries. It serves global corporate clients in sectors such as transportation, medical devices, and telecom.

LUMAXTECH.d: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited manufactures automotive components including lighting systems, gear shifters, and intake systems. Its primary customers are major Indian two-wheeler and four-wheeler manufacturers.

LUPIN.d: Lupin Limited manufactures and markets generic and branded pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients. Its products are distributed to global healthcare and retail markets.

LUXIND.d: Lux Industries Limited manufactures and markets innerwear, thermowear, and sleepwear for men, women, and children under brands like Genx and Onn. The company sells its products through a pan-India distributor network.

LXCHEM.d: Laxmi Organic Industries manufactures specialty chemicals, including acetyl intermediates and specialty intermediates. The company supplies global customers in the agrochemical, pharmaceutical, and dyestuff industries.
